detailed_description: The HTML Minifier works with pasted HTML text in the browser. Click Minify to remove comments, collapse whitespace, trim spacing around tags, and place the compact result in the output textarea. You can also click Beautify to add line breaks between adjacent tags and apply simple two-space indentation. The generated output can be copied with the Copy button. It is a lightweight text helper and does not provide configurable preservation rules, security obfuscation, HTML validation, or production build optimization.
usage_steps: Paste HTML into the input textarea.
Click Minify to generate a compact version, or Beautify to split tags onto separate lines.
Review the generated output in the readonly output textarea.
Use Copy to copy the current output.
usage_examples: Example 1: Remove extra spacing and comments from a small copied HTML snippet.
Example 2: Beautify a compact snippet to make tag boundaries easier to review.
Example 3: Compare pasted HTML with the compact output before using it in a local test.
Example 4: Copy a cleaned-up HTML snippet into another editor or demo page.
